Day 1: \(30\) pizzas.  
Day 2: \(\frac35 \cdot 20 = 12\) pizzas.  
Remaining for Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday: \(50-30-12=8\).

Let Wednesday be \(c\), Tuesday \(b\), Monday \(a\), with \(12 > a > b > c\) and \(a+b+c=8\).

To maximize \(c\), set \(a=c+2,\ b=c+1\):
\[
(c+2)+(c+1)+c=8 \Rightarrow 3c+3=8 \Rightarrow c \le \frac53
\]
Since \(c\) is an integer, \(c=1\).

\[
\boxed{1}
\]
